Dear Sir/Ma’am, In reference to the captioned matter, we hereby intimate your esteemed office, pursuant to Rule 22(1) (Ja) of the Securities Listing Bylaws, 2075 and Rule 26(5), Annex 16 (S.N. 9) of the Securities Registration and Issuance Regulations, 2073, that Mr. Ravishankar A. has tendered his resignation from the office of Director of Unilever Nepal Limited, which has been duly accepted by the Board with effect from 15th September 2026.
